00-aujourdhui: Today, we're learning the letter p.
02-regarde: Watch how we write the p.
03-depart: We start on the green dot. We go up with a curved stroke, we reach the top, and we come straight back down, vertically, all the way BELOW the line. And now, CAREFUL: we LIFT the pencil. We put it back at the top, we make an arch, and we finish with a little dip on the line.
04-encore: One more time, a little faster.
05-cherchons: Now, let's find words that begin with p.
10-pareil: Did you hear? They all begin the same way.
11-relance: Find a word that begins with p.
